ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 through L.561-53 of the French Monetary and Financial Code; Decree No. 2017-1094 of 6 June 2017 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE); EU Directives (EU) 2015/849 and (EU) 2018/843 as transposed; Tracfin AML/CFT regulatory guidelines; Article L.561-45 et seq. on beneficial ownership disclosure to French company registry.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory automated screening against EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list for all USD-denominated rails, French Treasury 'Asset Freeze' decisions, and Tracfin suspicious activity criteria. PEP identification is required for any shareholder or manager holding public office or occupying an equivalent position; enhanced due diligence applies when UBO stake is at or above 25% or any control relationship exists. Source-of-funds verification and transaction monitoring are mandatory for all government project wire transfers and letters of credit.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Infogreffe (www.infogreffe.fr) and National Institute of Industrial Property (INPI) database (data.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All French legal corporate documents, including the articles of association, must be drafted in French. The company name must be capable of being written in the Latin alphabet with standard French diacritics. Foreign words may be used but must not be misleading or contrary to French public order; a French translation or sufficient explanation is required for non-French trade terms where ambiguity may arise in the RCS registration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Greffe or INPI refuses the proposed name as misleading, contrary to public order, or conflicting with a prior RCS entry, the applicant must file a written 'recours gracieux' (pre-legal reconsideration request) with the issuing Registrar within 15 days of refusal. If the rejection is maintained, an emergency summary application ('référé') may be brought before the President of the Tribunal de Commerce having jurisdiction, pursuant to Articles R.123-30 and R.123-33 of the French Commercial Code. A final administrative appeal option lies with the Cour de cassation only on points of law; practical alternative is to resubmit an amended name after a 30-day cooling-off period.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditional: French law permits use of a licensed commercial domiciliation company ('société de domiciliation') for the registered office under Article L.123-11-2 of the Commercial Code. However, for ISIC 4220 pipeline EPC works, a pure virtual office without physical management presence is not sufficient for obtaining statutory construction licenses, bank accounts with project wire capabilities, or demonstrating genuine commercial substance. A physical operational office, even if small, must be maintained where the manager and project documentation can be inspected.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 70% chance of unannounced physical inspection by French labour, safety, and registry authorities during the initial 12 months of operation, and near-certainty (greater than 95%) once construction sites for high-pressure gas mains are active. Inspection authorities include the Direccte, Labour Inspection, and the Greffe in case of registered-office verification.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L. 223-1 to L. 223-43 (formation, operation and management of a Société à Responsabilité Limitée) and Articles R. 123-1 et seq. (registration with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés); the incorporation electronic procedure is governed by the law of 24 March 2014 and decree of 21 November 2022 on the Guichet Unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce territorially competent for the registered office, operating via the single electronic filing portal 'Guichet Unique' administered by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (private or notarized Articles of Association) filed together with Form M0 (déclaration de création d'entreprise) through the Guichet Unique; the completed file is transmitted to the Greffe which issues the extract K-bis.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The SARL has no statutory minimum share capital (minimum freely fixed, normally €1 or higher); paid-in capital must be effective at formation. Cash contributions must be deposited in a French bank account opened in the name of the company 'en formation' and blocked until registration; the banker issues an 'attestation de dépôt de fonds'. If the articles provide for staged release of capital, the unpaid balance must be paid within 5 years; for cash contributions, at least one-fifth (20%) is payable at subscription. Given the large-scale gas pipeline EPC activity, a paid-up capital of €50,000–€100,000 is recommended to satisfy bank tender warranties and surety lines.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF FR_SARL. Adopted this day by the subscribers of FR_SARL S.A.R.L. 1. Share Subscriptions. The subscribers unanimously subscribe the entire Share Capital of the Company of one hundred thousand euros (€100,000), fully paid in, and accept the share allocation set forth in the subscription list; the Gérant certifies receipt of the contributions. 2. Registered Office. The registered office is fixed at 12, Rue de la Bourse, 75002 Paris, France; the Gérant is directed to complete all registry filings and may relocate the office within the same department subject to a subsequent filing. 3. Officer Appointments. The subscribers appoint [Name] as Gérant with full powers to bind the Company, open bank accounts, sign EPC contracts, and execute the incorporation. Unanimously adopted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, KYC and Optional Notarization of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office notarial (Notaire) if notarized; otherwise private agreement to be registered at the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) competent for the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Statuts in the French language containing all mandatory clauses of Articles L. 223-1 to L. 223-7 of the Code de commerce: corporate name, legal form, registered office, corporate object (construction and welding of high-pressure gas pipelines), duration up to 99 years, share capital amounts, value of any in-kind contributions, distribution of shares, number and powers of the gérant(s), and conditions for transfer of shares. Complete shareholder and manager KYC; if an in-kind contribution exceeds €7,500 or more than half the share capital, have it valued by a statutory auditor (commissaire aux apports). Sign each page; notarization is optional for a SARL but recommended when a real-property lease contributes to the registered office or for subsequent share transfers.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts in French (original and copies)
Identity documents and passport copies of all shareholders and the gérant
Proof of registered-office availability (lease, occupancy consent or attestation de jouissance)
In-kind contribution valuation report of the commissaire aux apports, if applicable
Bank certificate or proof of the blocked capital deposit (may be produced at Step 2)
Declaration of beneficial ownership and non-conviction of the gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary or the SIE requires corrections, amend the Statuts and re-file; mandatory-clause deficiencies are cured by an acte rectificatif (supplementary deed) signed by all subscribers before submission to the Greffe.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Share Capital and Issuance of the Bank Blocking Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French commercial bank of the company's choice or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a non-trading bank account in the name 'FR_SARL, Société en formation' and deposit the full subscribed cash capital. The banker issues the 'attestation de dépôt de fonds' certifying that the funds are blocked and will be released only upon presentation of the K-bis extract. For international EPC tender purposes, also request a bank reference letter evidencing the paid-up capital and the company's solvency for warranty bonding.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts signed by subscribers
List of shareholders and managers with KYC information
Identity documents of the signatories
Bank account opening forms and AML source-of-funds documentation
Power of attorney of the agent handling the deposit, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises AML queries, provide source-of-wealth evidence; if the bank declines the account, elect a second establishment and renew the certificate. Where registration exceeds 8 working days, the bank certificate must be renewed or confirmed by the bank to maintain the blocked-funds undertaking.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Formation Announcement (Avis de constitution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized by the prefecture to receive legal advertisements in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Cause the mandatory notice to be published in an authorized legal announcement journal, including: corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, identity of the gérant, and the Greffe where the company will be registered. The JAL issues the 'attestation de parution' which must be appended to the formation file. The publication may occur before or immediately after submission of the M0 form, subject to the Guichet Unique verification deadlines.
required_dossiers: Completed announcement text using the standard Guichet Unique template
Power of attorney of the person ordering the publication
INPI name-reservation certificate, if obtained
Payment receipt of the publication fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the announcement contains printer's errors or administrative observations, publish a corrective notice (avis rectificatif) in the same JAL before the Greffe issues the K-bis, and transmit the rectification to the Guichet Unique.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Incorporation File with the Guichet Unique and the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique électronique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) operated by INPI, transmitting the dossier to the territorially competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for entry in the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the single digital incorporation file via Guichet Unique: Form M0, PDF of the signed Statuts, banker's deposit certificate, attestation of legal announcement, identity documents, attestation de jouissance for the registered office, declaration of non-conviction, and beneficial-ownership declaration. Pay the greffe and publication fees online. After validation, the Greffe registers the company in the RCS and issues the extract K-bis together with SIREN/SIRET identifiers and the NAF-APE code; verify that the APE code allocated is 42.21Z 'Construction de réseaux pour fluides' (construction of fluid distribution networks, including cross-country gas pipelines) and that the applicable BTP collective agreement (SMI-BTP) is correctly mentioned.
required_dossiers: Form M0 (déclaration de création d'entreprise) completed online
Statuts signed by all subscribers
Attestation de dépôt de fonds (bank blocking certificate)
Attestation de parution of the legal announcement
Identity documents of the gérant and shareholders
Attestation de jouissance or occupancy consent for the registered office
Declaration of non-conviction (casier judiciaire) of the gérant
Beneficial-ownership (BO) declaration
Optional INPI corporate-name reservation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On receipt of an 'avis de rejet' (rejection notice), rectify the stated deficiencies within 15 days via the Guichet Unique and resubmit; if processing exceeds the statutory period, renew the bank certificate and the legal-announcement attestation. In case of refusal by the Greffier, apply to the President of the Tribunal de Commerce in summary proceedings (référé) to order the registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Automatic INSEE and Tax Registration — SIREN/SIRET, APE 42.21Z, TVA Intra-Community Number
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE (Sirene system) in coordination with the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) and URSSAF.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon RCS registration, the Guichet Unique automatically triggers allocation of SIREN, SIRET, SIRUS and the NAF-APE code by INSEE. The company also receives the intra-community VAT number (numéro d'identification TVA) and is connected to the SIE for corporate income tax and VAT regimes. Verify that the registered activity mentions 'tranchées & soudage orbital de canalisations de transport de gaz' to justify APE 42.21Z; file the commencement-of-business declaration and the manager's salary/fiscal declarations (IFU) with the SIE.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract issued by the Greffe
Certified copy of the Statuts
Identity document and address certificate of the gérant
Bank account certificate
Brief activity description evidencing trenching and orbital welding for gas mains
Beneficial-ownership declaration received from the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the APE code is wrong, address a reasoned request to the INSEE statistics service (via the SIE) producing works contracts and site invoices so that the code is re-attributed to 42.21Z (or 42.22Z if primarily electricity/telecom); if the TVA number is missing, notify the SIE and obtain the 'extrait d'immatriculation' within the next 15 days; tax discrepancies are cured by an administrative objection (réclamation contentieuse).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Labour Registration, SPS Health & Safety Coordination and Mandatory Insurance for Construction Worksites
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DREETS (Direction Régionale de l'Économie, de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités), URSSAF, and the company's insurance carrier specialized in construction (BTP).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the 'déclaration préalable à l'embauche' (DPAE) with URSSAF for every employee; appoint a health-and-safety coordinator (CSPS) for the pipeline worksite and prepare the 'plan de prévention' and DIUO (dossier d'intervention ultérieure sur l'ouvrage) where the company acts as site contractor. Subscribe mandatory insurance covering civil liability, engineer's/worksite liability and 'RC décennale', and provide the worksite class attendance records. For orbital welding stations, implement ATEX-risk assessment and technical inspections of equipment before site mobilization.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract
Works contract or works order (marché) describing the pipeline scope
SPS plan prepared by the appointed coordinator
DIUO record or DIUO-project file, as applicable
Insurance policy certificates (RC exploitation, RC décennale, RC chantier)
Work equipment conformity and inspection records (CE marking, pressure equipment)
Staff qualification certificates for orbital welding (ISO 14731/EN 287-1) and first-aid (SST) cards
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DREETS issues an observation sheet, correct the SPS plan and DIUO within 5 working days and resubmit; if an insurer declines decennial cover for pipeline works, place a combined policy with a specialist international BTP insurer; if a site audit is triggered, comply immediately with corrective site notes and verify trench-shoring inspection certificates.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) — Service de prévention des risques, in coordination with the Préfet du département for public-utility easements (déclaration d'utilité publique, DUP) under the Code de l'énergie and the Code de l'environnement.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Arrêté préfectoral d'autorisation de construction et d'exploitation d'une canalisation de transport de gaz (delivered under Articles L. 551-1 and L. 553-3 of the Code de l'énergie), supplemented, insofar as the EPC contractor intervenes on the worksite, by the contractor's technical qualification certificate for orbital joining of high-pressure gas mains under the ministerial technical regulation of 7 February 2008 (règlement technique applicable aux canalisations de transport de gaz naturel) and the ISO 14731 welding-coordination requirements; for temporary site installations (offices, accommodation cabins, storage units) a temporary occupancy permit (permis de stationnement/permis précaire) is required from the Mairie.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition écologique / DREAL, with the consultative opinion of the Autorité Environnementale (CGEDD) and the CODERST commission.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category A — Full Environmental Impact Assessment (Étude d'impact) with mandatory public inquiry: under the decree of 22 October 2018 (Articles R. 122-2 et seq. of the Code de l'environnement, appendix I, item 24), gas-transport pipeline projects exceeding the length/pressure thresholds require a complete EIA; the operator obtains the 'autorisation environnementale unique', while the EPC contractor must implement the mitigation measures imposed in the arrêté and obtain its own 'dossier de déclaration de travaux' or 'enregistrement de chantier' for ancillary classified installations (ICPE) such as fuel depots or welding-gas storage.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater and site discharges must comply with the ministerial order of 2 February 1998 applicable to ICPE: pH 5.5–8.5, suspended solids (MES) ≤ 30 mg/L, chemical oxygen demand (COD) ≤ 125 mg/L, biochemical oxygen demand (BOD5) ≤ 30 mg/L, hydrocarbons ≤ 10 mg/L. Volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions from welding and coating works must respect the thresholds of Directive 2010/75/EU (IED) and the French regime for VOCs (Code de l'environnement, Articles L. 224-1 et seq.); welding-fume exposure is controlled by workplace atmospheric measurement against INRS occupational exposure limits. Excavated soils and drilling muds must be characterized as dangerous or inert waste, managed with a full waste tracking trail (bordereau de suivi de déchets, BSD) and disposed of in authorized facilities; contaminated soil from pipeline trenches is subject to the 'state of soil' obligations of Article L. 556-1 of the Code de l'environnement.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: hot-work permits ('permis de feu') are mandatory for every orbital welding station, with fire-extinguishing standby and gas-cutting safety measures under the Labour Code (Articles R. 4224-14 et seq.); site accommodation and storage cabins require a fire-safety certificate issued by the local commission de sécurité when the site is open to the public; structural-load inspections for deep trench shoring (paroi blindée) must be certified for trenches deeper than 1.20 m in accordance with Article L. 4535-2 of the Labour Code; occupational clearance is evidenced by welder qualification cards, ATEX-zone work permits for high-pressure gas mains, machine CE-marking and periodic technical inspections, and the SPS coordination plan approved by DREETS.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the official portal at impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must register with the DGFiP to obtain a SIREN/SIRET identifier and French TIN. The SOP requires submission of incorporation documents, articles of association, proof of registered office, and tax identification details through the formal registration process at the local tax office.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available. Standard SARL entities are subject to entity-level corporate taxation under French law unless specific regimes such as SIIC or hybrid mismatch elections under ATAD apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (facturation électronique) with XML format reporting to the DGFiP. All invoices require digital time-stamping and API integration for immediate clearance and compliance verification.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to exports of goods outside the EU and certain offshore services. Eligibility requires proof of actual export or performance abroad with no domestic supply or use.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Penalties up to 80% of evaded VAT plus interest and surcharges for fraudulent claims. Retrospective clawback of zero-rating with full adjustment and potential criminal sanctions for non-substantiated documentation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), acting as the French central bank and Eurosystem member, jointly with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury of the Ministry of the Economy) as the foreign-exchange and capital-control administration, and with the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) as the prudential supervisor of credit institutions and electronic-money institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full euro convertibility with no exchange controls: Articles 63-65 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union are applied without restriction, so current-account and capital-account transfers (dividends, repayment of shareholder advances, interest, fees, liquidation proceeds) are free for residents and non-residents without any central-bank licence or prior forex approval. The only residual frictions are (i) the DG Trésor foreign-investment screening regime for non-EEA investors in sensitive sectors, where cross-country oil and gas pipeline EPC activities are covered by Decree No. 2019-1590 if the investment confers control over French energy-infrastructure capabilities; and (ii) the corporate-law profit-remittance tests: the SARL must satisfy the statutory legal reserve requirement (5% of annual net profit until 10% of share capital is reached under Article L.232-10 of the Code de commerce), pass the balance-sheet net-asset test for distributions, and provide full KYC/source-of-funds evidence to the paying French bank. Dividend remittance wires are executed with purpose code DIVD and may require audited financial statements and a board/shareholders' resolution confirming the economic ownership of the beneficiary.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and filing of annual accounts, including statutory financial statements and applicable management report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Court Registry (Greffe du tribunal de commerce) via the Guichet unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Accounts must be approved within six months after financial year-end and filed within one month after approval, or within two months if filed electronically
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court injunction to file; civil fine generally up to EUR 1,500, or EUR 3,000 for repeat non-compliance; potential director liability and further RCS enforcement. No automatic strike-off occurs solely upon one missed filing, but persistent non-compliance after formal notice may support administrative RCS removal or judicial dissolution proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (Form 2065 and required schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French Tax Administration (Direction générale des finances publiques)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the financial year-end; for calendar-year companies, generally by the second business day after 1 May of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing interest and penalties, generally a 10% surcharge, increasing in cases involving formal notice, concealment, or repeated non-compliance. Persistent tax non-compliance may trigger enforcement and tax-authority collection measures, but not an automatic corporate strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate value-added tax annual reconciliation and final VAT return, where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French Tax Administration (Direction générale des finances publiques)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Timing depends on the VAT regime; annual reconciliation is generally submitted with the final VAT return or within the applicable annual filing period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing interest and penalties, generally including a 10% surcharge, with additional assessments for understated or unpaid VAT. Persistent default may result in tax collection enforcement and suspension or restriction of VAT compliance privileges.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local economic contribution compliance, including payment of Cotisation foncière des entreprises where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French Tax Administration and competent local tax office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: CFE is generally payable by 15 December annually; declarations are required only where applicable, including changes in premises or taxable circumstances
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest and tax surcharges may apply. The amount is determined by the taxable premises, municipality, and applicable exemptions; there is no fixed annual corporate renewal fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Register of Companies (Registre national des entreprises) through the Guichet unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No routine annual confirmation is required; changes to beneficial ownership or control information must generally be reported within one month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or inaccurate filing may result in formal notice, criminal sanctions for the legal representative, and possible judicial measures affecting the company’s registration status. There is no automatic annual strike-off deadline.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor is generally mandatory for a SARL exceeding at least two of the following thresholds at financial year-end: EUR 5 million total balance sheet, EUR 10 million net turnover, and 50 average employees. Additional group-company rules may apply. Sector-specific regulation, financing arrangements, or contractual requirements may also require an audit below these thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French Generally Accepted Accounting Principles under the French Accounting Standards Authority rules (Plan comptable général). IFRS may be used for qualifying consolidated accounts but is not generally required for standalone SARL accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not generally require an annual beneficial-owner confirmation. The SARL must update beneficial-owner information promptly, generally within one month after any change in ownership, control, or identifying information. Share transfers must be documented by transfer instruments, reflected in the company’s corporate records, and reported where they change registered company information or beneficial ownership.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register or file of shareholders, share ownership, and share transfer instruments
Register of shareholders' decisions and meeting minutes
Annual accounts, general ledger, journals, and supporting accounting records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 600-1,800 per year for a basic registered-office or domiciliation service; higher for operational premises, mail handling, or enhanced corporate administration
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 3,000-12,000 per year for a small or medium SARL; complex cross-border pipeline EPC operations, multiple sites, consolidation, or regulated-project controls may materially increase the fee

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate for financial years ending on or after 1 January 2022); 15% reduced rate on the first EUR 42,000 of taxable profit for qualifying SMEs (Art. 219 CGI).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Small business reduced rate 15% (up to EUR 42,000 profit); Research Tax Credit (CIR) 30% of qualifying R&D expenditure up to EUR 100M and 5% above; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) 20% up to EUR 400,000; renewable energy and regional employment incentives; indefinite loss carryforward with annual cap; 3-year loss carryback creditable against prior taxes.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (no statutory time limit; annual deduction cap of EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000, Art. 209 CGI).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065-SD (Cerfa 15946) 'Liasse fiscale', filed electronically through the EFI/GFD portal at impots.gouv.fr; includes annexes 2050 (balance sheet), 2051-2052 (income statement), 2053 (fixed assets), 2054 (depreciation), 2055 (provisions), 2056 (loss carryovers), 2057 (capital gains), 2058-A/B (related-party and transfer pricing), 2059 (tax schedule).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months of the fiscal year-end (Art. 223 CGI); for a 31 December year-end, the administrative deadline is generally 3 May; quarterly instalments (acomptes) due 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December; balance of tax due with the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income for corporate income tax purposes after deductions, loss offsets and fiscal adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare the French-source profit attributable to the French permanent establishment or the wholly French-taxable result of the SARL; add back non-deductible cross-border EPC costs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible loss carryforwards absorbed in the current year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Restrict to losses previously recognised in France; attach the 2056 loss schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable amount benefitting from the 15% reduced SME rate (first EUR 42,000).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm eligibility: turnover below EUR 10M, fully paid-up capital, and headcount/branch conditions; non-resident shareholders with EUR 10M+ turnover or group links apply the 25% rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of related-party transactions, transfer pricing policy, and intra-group remuneration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory for the French SARL when related-party transaction volume exceeds EUR 50M turnover threshold; describe pipeline EPC margins, intercompany guarantees and financing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual simplified transfer pricing return (politique de prix de transfert and documentation statement).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: File when turnover or gross assets exceed EUR 50M (Art. L13 AB LPF); disclose arm's-length treatment of cross-border oil and gas pipeline revenues, royalties and interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full transfer pricing documentation (Master File / Local File) declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Triggered at EUR 400M turnover or gross assets; embed CbCr report if group turnover exceeds EUR 750M; non-filing triggers EUR 15,000 fixed penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Distribution schedule and dividend withholding tax computation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the foreign corporate shareholder's country of residence; evidence entitlement to the EU Parent-Subsidiary 0% relief or an applicable DTA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Social contribution on corporate tax (3.3% on IS exceeding EUR 763,000) and exceptional contribution if applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident company with a French PE remains subject to the 3.3% social surcharge on the PE's French taxable income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: automatic 10% penalty on the assessed tax, increased to 40% after formal notice and 80% for fraudulent concealment; late-payment interest of 0.20% per month; minimum fine of EUR 150 for non-filing of the liasse; fixed fine of EUR 15,000 for missing transfer pricing documentation (Art. 1729 B CGI); 5% supplemental penalty for failure to file within 30 days of notice.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% domestic withholding on gross dividends paid to non-resident corporate shareholders (Art. 119 bis 2 CGI); 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for a qualifying parent holding at least 10% for 2 years; DTA-reduced rates generally 5% to 15% (e.g., France-US treaty: 5% for 10%+ corporate shareholders, 15% portfolio; France-UK and France-Germany: 0% under Directive alignment).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: (1) Obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the parent's home tax authority covering the payment date; (2) execute an attestation of beneficial ownership and absence of artificial arrangement; (3) submit Form 5013-SD (or an equivalently worded relief claim) plus the TRC and shareholding evidence to the French paying company's SIE before distribution; (4) for EU Parent-Subsidiary relief, provide a statement of the 2-year holding period and European corporate tax liability; (5) if tax was over-withheld, file a refund request with the SIE by 31 December of the second year following the year of collection; unresolved issues are escalated to the International Division of the DGFiP.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: domestic statutory withholding tax of 33.33% (Art. 125 A CGI); most French DTAs reduce the rate to 0% (e.g., France-US Art. 13, France-UK Art. 12, France-Germany Art. 12); 75% surcharge applies to royalties paid to persons established in non-cooperative jurisdictions (ETNC). Interest: domestic general rate 0% for arm's-length interest paid to non-residents; interest on shareholders' current accounts paid to non-resident corporate shareholders may be subject to 50% (EU/EEA treaty states) or 75% (ETNC) withholding under Art. 119 bis 2 bis CGI; treaty rates are typically 0%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Master File and Local File: EUR 400,000,000 in annual turnover or gross assets (entity or French group aggregate) under Art. L13 AA LPF; simplified annual TP return (Form 2258-SD): EUR 50,000,000; Country-by-Country Reporting: group consolidated turnover of EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France does not operate a designated ESR statute of the type used in offshore financial centres; however, economic substance is mandatory through the abuse-of-law doctrine (Art. L64 LPF), the ATAD-inspired GAAR and anti-hybrid rules (Art. 205 A CGI), and the substance requirements embedded in DTA entitlement. A French SARL engaged in cross-country oil and gas pipeline EPC must have genuine management, personnel, premises and risk-taking capacity in France; a 'letterbox' entity channelling project profits to a zero-tax affiliate will be disregarded and re-assessed.
